text:
jamie: Rolling out v0.9.3 to prod in ~30m. Canary at 5% for 10m. Who can take quick smoke checks + be ready to trigger rollback? rollback plan v2 is staged.

sara: I can do API health + latency. Will hit /health and run a short gen test. Watching p50/p95.

raul: I got error-rate, model-fallback tests, and trace sampling. I'll run the function-call path too.

ellen: I'll watch the Grafana dashboards (infra/redwood-prod + app/requests). Link in #observability if useful.

chao: I'll do embedding sanity and KV cache warm-up. Also verify quantization artifacts on a 50-sample set.

jamie: TL;DR checklist (quick):
  - health endpoint (HTTP 200)
  - p50/p95 latency (no >20% spike)
  - 5xx / error-rate (no regressions)
  - token cost/per-token anomalies
  - canary routing + fallback (force fallback path)
  - model version pin + rollout tags correct
  - rollback readiness (who has perms + playbook)

jamie: Example health check command (quick):
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.prod/health | jq
```

sara: Grafana quick query for p95 (cut/paste):
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="redwood-api"}[5m])) by (le))
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: v0.9.3 -> prod us-east-1 (5% traffic). Triggered by jamie.

raul: First 3 min - error-rate looks flat, but p95 +12% on generation route. Investigating host diff.

chao: Embedding checks: 48/50 match tolerance, 2 outliers look like quantization fuzz. Logging samples to object-store at s3://redwood-smoke/artifacts/1812345678.

ellen: Grafana: CPU spike aligned with the p95 bump, likely a kernel+quant combo. Tagging infra team.

jamie: If p95 keeps >10% bump for >10m, we'll rollback. Who can perform rollback if needed? (need someone with deploy perms)

raul: I can run the rollback; have perms and the playbook. Will coordinate with SRE.

deploy-bot: Canary checkpoint: 10m elapsed, metrics snapshot saved -> checkpoint id 202303-181234.

raul: Fixed small misroute (env var on one node). Re-ran smoke gen -> p95 back to baseline. Re-checking traces.

chao: Re-run embedding set: now 50/50 within tolerance. Looks like a warm-up + cache thing.

jamie: Great. Let's continue a slow rollout: bump to 20% for 15m, keep same watchers. If anything odd, rollback immediate.

ellen: Noted. I'm updating the runbook in #releases and will post a short summary after 20% check.

sara: Running final short gen suite now. All clear so far.

deploy-bot: Canary bumped to 20% (monitoring).

jamie: Nice work y'all. If anyone sees a regression, call it out here and @raul will trigger rollback. Otherwise we'll finish rollout after the 20m observation window. :thumbsup:
